moves.title: The roundup's slides carry the venue tag
moves.why: The roundup read 260, the fifth-best post ever, with nothing tagged in its slides. Tagged posts are the ones venues find and share.
moves.plan: From Wed Nov 11 every slide of the weekend roundup is tagged in the picture with its own venue and act, the way the single posts already are. The roundup read 260 this week, the account's fifth-best post ever, with nothing tagged in any slide. Say don't and the slides stay untagged.

moves.title: Half the posts go out a day early
moves.why: Two weeks in: a day early shared 3 of 12, day-of 4 of 13. Within one share of each other; it runs on, sides swapped again.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 28 half of each week's dated posts go out 24 hours before their old slot, the other half at the old time, swapping each week, so the venue and the act have a day to reshare. The review reads the two sides every Monday and picks the winner by Nov 23. Say don't and every post stays day-of.
